item.name: Cheese_Knife
item.description: Food-service knife used only for cheese preparation.
item.readyBeforeUse: The blade and handle are clean, sanitized, air-dry, and undamaged.
item.readyForNextPerson: During service, the knife is clean and remains on the protected work surface. After service, it is washed, rinsed, sanitized, air-dry, covered, and stored.
item.ifNotReady: Do not use a damaged or dirty knife. Tell the Food Lead.
